failure_modes.mode: Loss of Hydrogen Solubility / Gas Lock
failure_modes.cause: Pressure drop across long coil (23.5 m) or BPR fluctuation reduces local pressure below H2 saturation point, causing gas bubble expansion and flow instability in laminar regime (Re=33)
failure_modes.mitigation: Install back-pressure regulator with high precision (±0.1 bar) and upstream pressure sensor to ensure P_system > 5.0 bar consistently; implement gas-liquid segmented flow if single-phase dissolution is unstable

failure_modes.cause: Precipitation of reaction byproducts or catalyst leaching/agglomeration in narrow 0.5 mm ID tubing, exacerbated by low Reynolds number (Re=33) limiting self-cleaning shear forces
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement inline filtration (0.2 µm) before the reactor coil; schedule periodic high-flow purge cycles with pure solvent; select robust heterogeneous catalyst with minimal leaching

failure_modes.mode: Oxygen Ingress Leading to Runaway or Selectivity Loss
failure_modes.cause: O2-sensitive reaction environment compromised by leaks in fittings or permeation through tubing over time, introducing O2 into H2/Methanol mixture creating explosive limits or oxidizing sensitive intermediates
failure_modes.mitigation: Use metal-sealed fittings (e.g., VCR or Swagelok) instead of PTFE ferrules; install O2 sensor in exhaust line; maintain positive N2/H2 blanket in feed reservoirs

single_points_of_failure: Inline H2 mass flow controller (MFC) drift
validation_experiments: Pressure stability test: Run solvent-only at Q=0.42 mL/min and T=60°C for 24 hours; monitor pressure drift at BPR outlet to ensure <2% variation
Gas-liquid mass transfer verification: Measure H2 uptake rate vs. theoretical kLa at Re=33; confirm no gas slippage or channeling by analyzing conversion consistency over 10 consecutive runs
Fouling challenge test: Run reaction mixture for 50 residence times; monitor pressure drop increase across coil; if dP increases >10%, initiate cleaning protocol validation
